title: A “Perspectival” Mirror of the Elephant: Investigating Language Bias on Google, ChatGPT, YouTube, and Wikipedia
reasoning: The paper uses Buddhism as its primary case study to evaluate bias, examining how various digital platforms and languages represent religious and spiritual concepts such as karma, meditation, and Buddhist history. It also analyzes the moral and political implications of liberalism and neoliberalism, making faith and ethics a core component of its evaluation.
